title: About us — Supreme Art
description: Supreme Art makes pharmaceutical cartons, labels and leaflets in Pakistan on Heidelberg, Bobst and hot-stamping machinery, with specialised security coatings.

intro.heading: The paper box your medicine comes in — made on advanced machinery.
paragraphs: Supreme Art (Pvt) Ltd makes pharmaceutical cartons, labels and leaflets in Pakistan, on equipment chosen for precision: Heidelberg Speedmaster presses printing five colours and a coating in one pass, Bobst die-cutting and folder-gluing, a hot-stamping machine for foils and security finishes, and specialised coatings such as colour-shifting seals. A new high-quality carton inspection machine is being installed to add to our QC team's checks.
We work with pharmaceutical brands who need packaging that is accurate, consistent and traceable — because for medicine, the box is part of patient safety.
